 If the past few days are anything to go by, we're in for a wet, windy winter . And, having had such a brief transition out of those warmer summer days, you might also find yourself in the position I'm in: suddenly short on the new-season staples needed to see you through the colder months.
 Thinking it was crunch time to invest in a new pair of boots , I was instead inspired by Lila Moss , who just stepped out in the wet weather wearing an autumn shoe trend that works just as well through the depths of winter.
 (Image credit: Backgrid) Provided you pair them with a snug pair of socks, sleek leather loafers make surprisingly capable companions for rainy days. Spotted navigating the drizzly streets beneath her umbrella, Lila styled hers with a black wool coat , tailored trousers and a chunky knit, creating an outfit I'll be taking inspiration from throughout winter's rainiest days.
 Latest Videos From Who What Wear Comfortable and versatile, leather loafers offer a streamlined alternative to your usual wet-weather footwear. Whilst a pair of boots might have felt a little heavy against Lila's otherwise sleek, all-black ensemble, her loafers brought a lightness without sacrificing practicality.
 Always inspired by the Lila, I've rounded up the leather loafers worth considering below.
